note: TRUST ROOT for owner-gated promotion. The owner generates a signing key OUTSIDE the agent environment, computes its SHA-256, and replaces OWNER_TO_SET below. The promotion program refuses to promote while this is the placeholder (KEY_NOT_PINNED) and refuses any key file whose SHA-256 does not equal the pinned value. This file is committed: changing it is a visible git diff the owner reviews - that visibility, plus the owner holding the key, IS the trust model. No program can conjure a trust root the owner has not set.
